#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <regex>
#include <sstream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

using namespace std;

vector<string> split(const string& s, char delim) {
    vector<string> tokens;
    stringstream ss(s);
    string token;
    while (getline(ss, token, delim)) {
        tokens.push_back(token);
    }
    return tokens;
}

long countInside(const string& inner) {
    long count = 0;
    vector<string> parts = split(inner, '_');
    for (const string& part : parts) {
        if (!part.empty()) {
            count++;
        }
    }
    return count;
}

int main() {
    int n;
    string s;
    cin >> n >> s;

    regex pattern("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
    string replaced = regex_replace(s, pattern, "_");

    vector<string> parts = split(replaced, '_');
    int longest = 0;
    for (const string& part : parts) {
        longest = max(longest, (int)part.length());
    }

    long inside = 0;
    smatch m;
    string::const_iterator searchStart(s.cbegin());
    while (regex_search(searchStart, s.cend(), m, pattern)) {
        string inner = m.str().substr(1, m.str().length() - 2);
        inside += countInside(inner);
        searchStart = m.suffix().first;
    }

    cout << longest << " " << inside << endl;
    return 0;
}
